office_does: Hears and decides misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders in King County District Court for a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: sitting District Court Judge Andrea Samonica Jarmon is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Sitting King County District Court judge whose prior career included work as a prosecutor, Assistant Attorney General, administrative law judge, and attorney in criminal and civil matters.
highlights: Reports fifteen years of experience across prosecution, the Attorney General's office, administrative law judging, and private representation [S1]
Says she reduced her dockets and streamlined pre-trial hearing calendars [S1]
Says she created civic engagement programs introducing young people to legal careers [S1]
